shortDescription: Shares of Paytm NSE:PAYTM, One Mobikwik NSE:MOBIKWIK, Yes Bank NSE:YESBANK advanced on Wednesday after India's payments authority introduced a 0.4% fee on select person-to-merchant transactions above 2,000 rupees (about $20) from October 15.Paytm, One Mobikwik, Yes Bank and Axis Bank gained between…

children: advanced on Wednesday after India's payments authority introduced a 0.4% fee on select person-to-merchant transactions above 2,000 rupees (about $20) from October 15.
Paytm, One Mobikwik, Yes Bank and Axis Bank gained between 2%-8% in early trade on Wednesday, while Axis Bank gained about 0.8%. Pine Labs
, which rose about 2.2%, reversed gains to trade 3.2% lower.
